verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS productivity suite like Google Workspace, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing where data is stored. The only location-related item is Context-Aware Access, which uses user location as an access-control attribute. That is an adjacent control, not storage-region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
